issue.title: [BUG] ```Channel.video_urls``` returns ```YouTube``` objects instead of strings
issue.body:
## 🐞 **Bug Description**  
According to the [documentation](https://pytubefix.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html#pytubefix.contrib.channel.Channel.video_urls) the ```Channel.video_urls``` method should return a list of strings, but instead it returns a list of ```YouTube``` objects: 

```
[[], <pytubefix.__main__.YouTube object: videoId=WzqL89hb25w>, <pytubefix.__main__.YouTube object: videoId=es5ThfPNokI>, <pytubefix.__main__.YouTube object: videoId=CWTHgahgStQ>, ...]
```

---

## 🔢 **Code Snippet**    

```python
from pytubefix import Channel

c = Channel("https://www.youtube.com/@YouTube")

print(c.video_urls)
```

---

## 🎯 **Expected Behavior**  

> property video_urls: DeferredGeneratorList
> Complete links of all the videos in playlist
> Return type: List[str]
> Returns: List of video URLs

---

## 📸 **Screenshots or Logs**  

---

## 🖥️ **Environment Details**  
Fill in the details below about your setup:  
- **Operating System:** Windows 11 
- **Python Version:** 3.12.10  
- **Pytubefix Version:** 10.6.1  

---

## 📋 **Additional Context**  
Add any additional information or context that might help us resolve the issue.  

---
### 🚀 **Next Steps**  
Once submitted, we will triage the issue. Make sure to respond to follow-up questions to keep the process smooth.

expected.cause: Channel.url_generator in pytubefix/contrib/channel.py yields the raw extracted objects (YouTube instances and nested lists) instead of watch URLs, contradicting the documented List[str] return type of video_urls.
